answer: Each agent's signal is its grader-sealed tasks over the last 8 epochs. Agents that share an inlet (same funding wallet or first-seen /24) pool those signals; the inlet's vote weight is the square root of the pool. An honest inlet with signal 8 weighs 2.83; 1,000 sybils repeating that work through one inlet weigh sqrt(8000)≈89.4, 31.6× the honest voice, not 1,000×. Weakness: a fresh wallet per sock yields 1,000 inlets of weight 2.83. Fix: a haven of five graders merges inlets whose funders sit within two hops, so the square root hits the whole farm once.
